security_voluntary_transfer_004.answer: Voluntary transfers require certification, tenure status, and seniority as criteria. Requests are due by March 1, with post-March 1 requests allowed only for extenuating circumstances and 5+ years of service. Accepted applicants are placed on lists of up to five most senior individuals. Transfers require written acceptance by the applicant and Principal within one week of an interview.
security_voluntary_transfer_004.evidence: Factors to be considered: a. Certification for the position desired. b. Tenure status; i.e., except in unusual circumstances, only tenured teachers will be considered for voluntary transfers. c. Seniority. / Requests for voluntary transfers to known vacancies may be submitted after March 1, but will be considered only in extenuating or unusual circumstances and only from teachers with five or more years of service... / The Division of Human Resources will establish lists for each subject field assignment... include a maximum of the five (5) most senior transfer applicants who have been accepted by the Principal and who have submitted their written acceptance for transfer.

security_involuntary_transfer_005.answer: Yes. Procedures use a sequential selection order: volunteers first, then those with less than a standard certificate, then the least senior person in the county within the affected school/category. Teachers are offered up to two interviews with two workdays to decide. Transferred teachers are prioritized over new hires and those returning from leave, and ahead of voluntary requests after August 1. A three-year moratorium applies after a first-day transfer.
security_involuntary_transfer_005.evidence: 1. Volunteer(s) shall first be sought... 2. Persons holding less than a standard certificate in the subject or teaching level to which they are assigned shall then be selected and 3. Should the previous two steps not satisfy the required transfer, the decision shall be made according to: a. The least senior person in the County in that school within the category affected. / A maximum of two interviews to Principals of schools where there are appropriate vacancies... A maximum of two (2) work days after the referral will be permitted for the teacher to advise the Division of Human Resources regarding the acceptance or non-acceptance of the position. / Teachers to be involuntarily transferred will be reassigned ahead of teachers returning from an approved leave of absence and new hires. After August 1, teachers to be involuntarily transferred will be reassigned ahead of teachers requesting voluntary transfers.

security_rif_006.answer: RIF is triggered by budget cuts, declining enrollment, or reorganization, prioritizing reassignment with 6 credits/year for new certification. If layoffs are necessary, they follow a strict order: first provisional certificate holders (least senior), second non-tenured employees, third tenured Class II, and fourth tenured first-class certificate holders (all least senior in field). Laid-off staff receive 4 days' notice, retain recall rights for 3 years, and may pay insurance premiums.
security_rif_006.evidence: professional personnel shall be laid off solely on the basis of certification in the subject field assignment and on system-wide seniority as defined in Article 4.01.10. / First: In continuing order of least system-wide seniority in the subject field taught, severance shall be restricted to persons holding a provisional certificate. Second: Thereafter, in continuing order of least system-wide seniority in the subject field taught, severance shall be restricted to non-tenured employees. Third: Thereafter, in continuing order of least system-wide seniority, tenured employees holding a Class II certificate. Fourth: Thereafter, in continuing order of least system-wide seniority, tenured employees holding first class certificates. / Professional Personnel shall (a) receive official notice by phone or registered mail at least four (4) working days in advance of their deadline for determining whether to exercise recall rights, (b) shall be available to begin within thirty (30) days, (c) retain recall rights for a period of three (3) years
